description.en: The round elastic cord class, a stretching rubber core (bare or covered with yarn) about 1 to 1.5 mm across, sold by length. Its ends thread through holes in a sheet and are knotted or glued behind: a band that closes a box or a booklet, or a loop that holds a part.
description.es: La clase de cordón elástico redondo, un núcleo de caucho que estira (desnudo o forrado de hilo) de entre 1 y 1.5 mm de grosor, vendido por metro. Sus extremos pasan por barrenos de una hoja y se anudan o se pegan por detrás: una banda que cierra una caja o un cuadernillo, o una presilla que sujeta una pieza.
description.fr: La classe de cordon élastique rond, une âme en caoutchouc extensible (nue ou guipée de fil) d'environ 1 à 1,5 mm de diamètre, vendue au mètre. Ses extrémités passent par des trous d'une feuille et sont nouées ou collées derrière : une bande qui ferme une boîte ou un carnet, ou une boucle qui tient une pièce.
description.pt: A classe de cordão elástico roliço, um núcleo de borracha que estica (nu ou revestido de fio) com cerca de 1 a 1,5 mm de diâmetro, vendido a metro. As pontas passam por furos de uma folha e são atadas ou coladas por trás: uma faixa que fecha uma caixa ou um caderno, ou uma alça que segura uma peça.

frame_convention: The cord laid straight. Origin at end A, on the cord's axis; +x runs along the cord to end B at x = length_mm; +y and +z are radial references (the cord is round, so both ends have continuous symmetry). A real cord follows a path, not this line.

diameter_min.note: Beadalon Elasticity, 0.039 in (1.0 mm) as listed

parameters.note: A convention bounded by the two cited members (1.0 and 1.5 mm); cords of other diameters exist but are not cited here. No frame reads it: the hole a cord passes through is the host's design.
A convention, not a sourced fact: the cord is cut to suit. The maximum is the cited Prym card's 3 m.

interfaces.note: Male: end A threads through a hole in a sheet and is knotted or glued behind it. The normal points out of the end, toward the hole.
Male: end B, length_mm along the cord, as end A.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (K3 lane, 2026-10-10); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: A class entry: only the round section and the cited diameters are facts. Stretch, breaking load and core material vary by maker and are not stated by the cited listings. No envelope: like a belt, a cord is a path, not a rigid body.
